# The Guide's prompts

<!-- generated by `node solo.js prompts export --for docs` from core/prompts.js: edit that file, then run the export; never this one -->

Every built-in prompt, generated from `core/prompts.js`. How the Guide works, its settings and the reply rules: [guide.md](guide.md). The full text of one prompt: `node solo.js prompts show <slug>` (`--mode chat` for the chat version).

**Files** = an agent that runs commands (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex): it runs `node solo.js` itself; every prompt is also a slash command. **Chat** = ChatGPT, Claude.ai: the prompt carries the context and, when it changes something, the reply format; the answer comes back through the Guide's Reply.

## Per page

What the Guide shows first on each page. **Start** is the top block of Ask: on Home, Board and Calendar (and Overview) it is *Start here* while the project is empty (bring-in, plan-project, fill-calendar) and then, on Home, Board and Calendar, the moment of the day (morning: start-day, now, plan-today · afternoon: now, capture, steps · evening: wrap, now, capture); elsewhere it is the page's own first three. **For this page** follows without the prompts Start shows (on Home, Board and Calendar those depend on the hour, so the column lists them all); on an empty project it offers only: bring-in, plan-project, fill-calendar, tasks-from-list, capture, script, post-ideas, assess-inspo, use-inspo, setup-video, backup-setup, backup, restore, undo-agent, second-opinion.

| Page | File | Start | For this page (first) | Sends along (ticked) | This page (help) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home | `index.html` | Start here / the moment of the day | start-day, now, wrap, bring-in, plan-week, standup, overdue, stuck, second-opinion, week, close-week, overcommitted, plan-project, tasks-from-list, cleanup, cut-scope, capture, draft-posts, ship-post, post-ideas, assess-inspo, use-inspo, cut-take, fill-calendar, plan-today, setup-video, backup-setup, backup, restore, undo-agent | recent, schedule | Today across your projects: what is on now, what is in Doing, the week, your inbox and what changed. Each project card opens its Overview (boards, apps, rename). The quick add puts a task in the open project; the Workspace menu in the nav switches it. Your AI: Start with one at the top of Ask, or /menu in your agent. |
| Project overview | `overview.html` | plan-week, week, cleanup | cut-scope, overcommitted, close-week, plan-project, bring-in | project, recent | One project in detail: its boards with their progress, its apps (schedule, scripts, drafts, video) with what is in each, and Rename / Apps / Remove. Home shows every project; this page shows the one in the address. For this page: plan or review the week of this project, clean up its board, cut scope to a date. |
| Board | `runway/marathon-board.html` | Start here / the moment of the day | now, steps, stuck, tasks-from-list, bring-in, standup, start-day, overdue, wrap, second-opinion, week, overcommitted, cleanup, cut-scope, capture, ship-post, plan-today | this, board | One board = one kanban: To Do → Doing → Done, a Later parking lot and a Bucket List for ideas. Cards carry checklists, priority, project, tags and private notes. A card tagged writing, script or video also carries its pieces: Draft, Script, Take and Post as pills, one next step that makes the piece for it, and attach for one that exists. n adds a task · 1 / 2 / 3 switch views · ⌘K runs "add Fix the hero @launch #copy !high". |
| Calendar | `calendar/calendar.html` | Start here / the moment of the day | overdue, fill-calendar, plan-today, start-day, standup, bring-in | schedule, recent | Everything with a date, in one place: tasks with a time or a deadline, meetings (a task with a time and the tag meeting), and posts. Agenda shows today onward with overdue first; Month shows the grid. Filter by board, meetings, posts; tick to finish; click to open the item where it lives. Three ways in: + Add here, the + date chip on any card, or an agent: Ask → Fill my calendar reads the calendar it is connected to. Terminal: `node solo.js add "Call with X" --at tomorrow 14:00 --until 14:30 --tags meeting`; `node solo.js calendar` prints this agenda. |

A posting arc: each post has a date, copy, type, prep checklist, images and video status. Mark it posted to log engagement. Status: draft → ready → scheduled → posted. |

The schedule itself (copy, prep, dates) is on Social Schedule. For this page: ideas from what you are building, copy for the posts that have none, one post about what you just shipped. |
| Script Viewer | `studio/script-viewer.html` | script, improve, ten-hooks | repurpose, second-opinion, cut-take, ship-video | this | Connect with a task… (in the toolbar) puts this script on a board card; the card then shows it as a pill with the draft, the take and the post. Tasks tagged script show at the top of the list as suggestions. Short-form scripts with a light structure: # Title, ## Hook, ## Script (numbered beats), ## Inserts, ## Prep. Reader shows spoken lines only; 9:16 previews the phone; Teleprompter scrolls at your pace. |
| Writing Viewer | `studio/writing-viewer.html` | edit-draft, improve, ten-hooks | repurpose, second-opinion | this | Connect with a task… (in the toolbar) puts this draft on a board card; tasks tagged writing show at the top of the list as suggestions, with Write the draft. Drafts with track changes you and your agent both read: ~~cut~~, ++add++, [[note for the AI]]. Copy for AI sends the markup; Copy clean sends the final text. |
| Video | `studio/video.html` | cut-take, ship-video, setup-video |  | take | In the toolbar: the task this take belongs to, with its pills, or Connect with a task… (pick a board, find the task, or make a new one); tasks tagged video show at the top of the list with Add the take. Click a word and press Space: the take plays from there with your cuts skipped, the captions on it. Select the part you want and press K (Keep only this): the trim. Remove fillers and pauses takes um, uh and the long pauses in one click; Review first lists each one, and what was said twice, before you remove them. A misheard word: select it, press C, retype it. Render a preview, then the final with captions, and watch them in the same player. Every cut is saved and logged; Undo takes it back. Cut it with my AI: the words go to your agent, it proposes the cut, you say yes, and the cut lands here. Terminal: `node solo.js video show <take>` prints the same words. |
| Inspiration | `inspo/inspiration.html` | assess-inspo, use-inspo, script | post-ideas, second-opinion | inspiration_new | Everything worth keeping lands here. Tag with a project, then Use as task / post / script / draft, or tick a few and Brainstorm with AI. The capture strip on every page saves here. |
| About | `about.html` | bring-in, plan-project, fill-calendar |  | recent | What Solo Ops is, who it is for, the three ways in (just you, a chat, an agent that runs commands) and what is coming. Your data stays in a folder on this computer. Start here: bring your work in, plan a project, or fill your calendar. |

## The menu (`/menu`, `node solo.js menu`)

```
What you can ask me here. Type the command, or just say it in plain words.

Get started:
  /bring-in       Bring in my work
  /plan-project   Plan a project from scratch
  /fill-calendar  Fill my calendar

Every morning:
  /start-day      Start my day
  /now            What should I do right now?
  /plan-today     Plan today around my meetings

During the day:
  /capture        Turn this conversation into tasks
  /steps          Break this task into steps
  /stuck          I'm stuck

Every evening:
  /wrap           Wrap up the day

Every week:
  /plan-week      Plan the week
  /week           Review my week
  /close-week     Close the week

Make content:
  /script         Write a script from an idea
  /draft-posts    Draft next week's posts
  /cut-take       Cut this take
  /assess-inspo   Assess new inspiration

Keep it safe:
  /backup         Back up now
  /undo-agent     Undo what the agent just did

All 39 commands: node solo.js prompts builtin
The pages: node serve.js, then the Guide (? on the left edge).
```

## The reply format (what a chat answer may carry)

```
HOW TO REPLY WITH CHANGES (the app applies these lines itself; nothing else runs):
Put the commands at the end of your reply in one ``` block, one per line, in order.
  add "Title" --pri high|medium|low --tags a,b --steps "step|step" [--board <id>] [--col todo|doing|done|later|bucket] [--at 2026-10-15T14:00 | tomorrow 14:00] [--until 15:00] [--due 2026-10-20] [--notes "link or note"]
  add … --ext <tool>:<its id> (an item from another tool: the same ext again updates that task instead of adding it twice) · done ext:<tool>:<its id>
  at <task> <when|clear> · due <task> <date|clear>   (a meeting = a task with --at and --tags meeting)
  start | done | later | bucket | todo <id or title fragment>
  move <task> todo|doing|done|later|bucket · pri <task> high|medium|low · tag <task> +a -b
  step <task> "text" · check <task> <n> · note <task> "text"
  social add "Title" --at 2026-10-20T09:00 (or +3d 17:30) --type launch --copy "…" --prep "a|b"
  social copy <post> "text" · social prep <post> "item" · social move <post> <when> · social ready|posted <post>
  scripts add "Title" / notes add "Title": that line alone, then the full text in its own ``` block right under it
  scripts set <id> / notes set <id>: the same, and the text replaces what the script or draft says now
  inspo tag <item> +a +b · inspo ws <item> <project id> · inspo archive <item> · inspo use <item> --as task|post|script|note
Ids are the [t…] [p…] [s…] [n…] [i…] in the snapshot; new items get no id. Never rm (it is ignored).
A plain "- [ ] task" checklist with indented "- [ ] step" lines also works.
```
